title: 🪓 We love David vs. Goliath — until David works in HR and files a report.
paragraphs:
🪓 We love David vs. Goliath — until David works in HR and files a report.
😂💼🙏

Because sometimes faith doesn’t swing a sword…
…it files an incident report and CC’s heaven. ☁️📋

Meet David, the whistleblower with a slingshot-shaped USB stick —
and Goliath, the corporate giant made of gold armor and PR statements. 🏢⚔️
Would you still cheer David… if he was your coworker? 👀

🎬 “David vs. Goliath: The Whistleblower”
— A modern-day parable of courage, coffee, and calling out the giants.

“Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?”
— Galatians 4:16
